name: Ecommerce Hero
description: Commerce hero: brand-dash eyebrow, display heading with a hand-drawn underline, intro and primary CTA beside a floating dashboard collage (product card with sizes and Add to Cart, sales/orders stat cards with count-ups, brand gauge card, in-stock tag) over a tilted soft stage, plus a muted logo band.
interactions: collage cards rise in (translateY 20px -> 0, 600ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), 110ms stagger) at 25% viewport via IntersectionObserver
dashboard numbers count up once over 1s with cubic ease-out ($765.50 with decimals, 4,367 grouped, 345)
sale and orders cards float gently forever (wpmn-ech-float, 6s/7s ease-in-out, offset phases)
CTA follows design-system primary states at 120ms
prefers-reduced-motion: floats and reveals off, numbers set instantly
